aToB.memory: Every journalistic bone in Finn's body vibrates whenever Prof. Marlowe glides past with that star-anise perfume and unreadable golden-amber smile. Rumor says she personally signed an emergency override to pull an anomalous, twenty-year-old Earth transfer like Leo Vance straight through the Waystone portal into Starlight Tower despite conservative Ministry protests, then parried Finn's sharpest ambush questions outside the Potions & Alchemy Lab with velvet half-truths that sent him chasing three false leads.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Finn wants to catch Prof. Marlowe stepping out of the Potions & Alchemy Lab with a disarmingly specific question about Waystone arrival anomalies, watching closely for even half a second of surprise before her polite smile locks back down.

bToA.memory: Evelyn finds young Finnian Reed bright enough to notice anomalies faster than most faculty—which makes him mildly inconvenient while she keeps Leo Vance's Earth signature out of Ministry hands. She addresses him coolly as 'Finnian' whenever his brass camera gets too nosy near her lab door and feeds him dazzling Dimensional Theory tangents to keep his column chasing harmless distractions.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Evelyn wants to intercept Finnian neatly near the Potions & Alchemy Lab or Familiar's Perch Cafe, redirect his breathless questions about Waystone transfers toward safe student-club gossip, and gauge just how much he has already pieced together.
